Town of Bakersfield official website, 'Officials & Commissions' page (read October 17, 2026), prints the treasurer as 'Tom Jamison'; the Secretary of State Guide form 'Thomas Jamison' is recorded. The Secretary of State's treasurer spreadsheet publishes no Bakersfield treasurer.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (last updated December 4, 2025), Bakersfield (Franklin County): Pauline Cosgrove, Patrick Evans, Brenda Churchill, Arlene O'Rourke, Sarah Willey Marcotte, Janice Ketchum Marcotte, Mark Doremus. The listing presents the justices elected November 5, 2024.

Town of Bakersfield official website, 'Officials & Commissions' page (read October 17, 2026): Town Listers Tamera Brennan (Co-Chair), Sharon Evans (Co-Chair). Two of the board's three seats are named on the page.

Office established for Vermont towns by 17 V.S.A. section 2646 (moderator, elected annually). No official source found as of 2026-10-17 publishes the current Bakersfield holder; the post is created as structure only and the membership awaits the printed annual town report or a clerk records reply.

Office established for Vermont towns by 17 V.S.A. section 2646 (auditors elected at annual meeting; three serve staggered three-year terms under section 2651. A town may vote to eliminate the office and engage a public accountant under section 2651b; whether this town has done so is not determinable from published sources). No official source found as of 2026-10-17 publishes the current Bakersfield holder; the post is created as structure only and the membership awaits the printed annual town report or a clerk records reply.
